title: EduProSphere
description: EduManage is a robust and user-friendly platform designed to revolutionize the way educational institutions, tutors, and students interact. Leveraging the power of the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js), EduManage aims to make skill learning and class management more efficient and accessible than ever before.

title: StudyHive
description: The Online Group-Study web application allows users to collaborate with their friends by creating assignments, completing them, and grading others' submissions. This platform encourages group study, where users can track their progress, submit assignments, and provide feedback to their peers.
